headline: Colonials Deepen Hold in Callahan's Passage as Berm Rekindles
war_summary: Callahan's Passage has slipped further from the Wardens: Colonials now hold a second of its ten strongholds, and the fighting there is the war's fiercest, with casualties on both sides accelerating by the hour—more than ten thousand fallen from each army in a day. Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage saw the heaviest toll. The Nevish Line tells the other story: the Colonial foothold there has narrowed to two of eight posts after thirty-nine actions, though the churn has thinned in recent hours. Palantine Berm, silent since midnight in our last edition, has rekindled, Leiri Hermanni again the storm-center, though the flags remain unchanged. Stlican Shelf still smolders at Briar and filed the freshest action of the day as this dispatch went to press, its casualty rates at last cooling. The Weathered Expanse grinds on, seven posts Colonial and two in ruins, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest again busiest. The quiet maps still bleed—Mooring County counted more than ten thousand combined casualties in a day with its twelve posts still Warden, while Linn of Mercy's burst has cooled. It is day 499; thirty-four victory towns will settle this war, and no victor is yet named.
